name: Moonshine Partner Lane
blurb: Designed for partners who can qualify. Clear lanes, clear expectations, and a focus on funded outcomes—not signup counts.

name: Direct Lender Referral
blurb: Simple referral structure. Great when you have warm intros and want minimal packaging responsibilities.

name: Broker Network (Multi-product)
blurb: More products and more edge cases. Great upside if you can package files and manage expectations.

name: MCA-Heavy Affiliate Program
blurb: Fast path to ‘wins’ but often requires aggressive volume and thick follow-up. Watch client fit and churn.

name: SBA/Term Loan Referral
blurb: Higher quality borrowers, longer cycle, more documentation. Great for patient operators with strong qualification.
commissionSummary: Small CPA or split on close

name: Invoice Factoring Partner
blurb: Solid for B2B with invoicing. The trick is verifying debtor quality and terms before you promise anything.

name: Equipment Financing Referral
blurb: Easy story to sell (asset-backed). Still requires clean docs and realistic timelines.

name: Line of Credit Partner
blurb: Owners like LOCs. Underwriting likes consistency. Your job is to verify revenue stability before you pitch limits.

name: Ecom Funding Affiliate
blurb: Works when you understand platform statements and margins. Fails when you pitch generic ‘funding’ to store owners.

name: Merchant Services Cross-Sell
blurb: If you already sell payments, funding referrals can work—if you don’t torch trust with bait-and-switch claims.

name: Agency White-Label Partner
blurb: Bigger upside, bigger responsibility. You own branding, process, and expectations. You’re a broker business now.

name: Lead Marketplace (Pay per lead)
blurb: Sounds easy. Often turns into calling the same exhausted owners as everyone else. Works only with tight niche + speed.
